newsitem.title: USA: Fla citrus groves drenched from Josephine.
newsitem.headline: Fla citrus groves drenched from Josephine.

text.p: Most citrus groves throughout the Florida Citrus Belt were hit by Hurricane Josephine, which soaked trees during the week ended Oct 13, Florida Statistics Service (FASS), said.

"Rains with Tropical Storm Josephine and bands of moisture associated with that storm covered most rural grove areas with amounts up to 7 inches," FASS said in its weekly weather and crop news report.
Milder weather during the second half of the week allowed field work to resume according to schedule.
High temperatures reached the mid-80s (Fahrenheit) and lows dipped into the low 60s (Fahrenheit), accounting for the coolest temperatures so far this season.
FASS said harvest of early season fruit is increasing as more groves and trees are passing minimum maturity tests.
